full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 2273, February 5, 2010>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on February 11, 2010.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Scope of Adjudicative Affairs) Cases to be tried by outlying divisions of the Seoul High Court and Busan High Court under amended Article 2 that are pending before the Seoul High Court or Busan High Court as of February 10, 2010 shall continue to be tried by the respective courts in which they are pending.
